title: I added a drivable pickup
body:
The pickup starts at speed and skids around a corner in Quartz City. The wheel camera shows the suspension over a bump, then the rear view shows the loose cartons jolt as the truck crosses a ramp. In Quartz County, the truck revs in the air off a ridge. A low front camera catches the jump, then a wider shot follows the rollover.

I fixed the cargo crossing into the cab on hard impacts. Cartons that were frozen in older saves also wake up where they were saved.

videos.caption: A fast city skid, a close look at the suspension and loose cargo, and a ridge jump with an airborne rev and rollover.
